title: WAC 192-540-050, When are employers required to submit quarterly reports to the department?

passages.question: When were the Q3 2026 Paid Leave and WA Cares report and premiums due?
passages.excerpt: The quarterly reports referenced in WAC 192-540-030 must be submitted by the last day of the month following the end of the calendar quarter being reported. If a reporting date falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or a legal holiday, the reports will be due on the next business day.
